name: Lobes VR - Audio Coverage
summary:
Lobes VR - Audio Coverage is a VR/MR educational tool designed to help students, teachers, sound engineers, and audio technicians visualize how microphones and loudspeakers behave in space.

The app lets users explore microphone polar patterns and speaker coverage in an immersive 3D environment. By placing and interacting with different microphones and speakers, users can better understand directionality, coverage areas, frequency behavior, and the relationship between sound sources and listening positions.
